summary: Matt is planning a 7-day solo trip to Japan, flying from Raleigh-Durham (RDU). The trip moved from December 8–15, 2026 to the first week of March 2027. Proposed dates: leave RDU Mon Mar 1, 2027 and arrive in Tokyo Tue Mar 2 because of the date line. Tokyo hotel nights are Mar 2–6, with checkout Mar 7. Shinkansen to Osaka on Sun Mar 7. Osaka hotel nights are Mar 7–8, with checkout Mar 9. Fly home from Osaka (KIX) Tue Mar 9. That makes 5 nights in Tokyo (Shibuya base) and 2 in Osaka, 7 hotel nights total. These dates are proposed, not yet confirmed by Matt. Early March falls before cherry blossom season, which usually means fewer crowds and lower prices than late March, though it is chilly. Hotel budget is USD $150–200/night, upscale boutique style. Interests: streetwear, sneaker and vintage shopping, Japanese food, and nightlife. Matt wakes around 11 AM–12 PM and wants only 1–2 touristy activities. Days: Day 1 (Mar 2) arrive and settle in Shibuya; Day 2 (Mar 3) Harajuku/Omotesando/Cat Street; Day 3 (Mar 4) Shimokitazawa vintage; Day 4 (Mar 5) Asakusa/Senso-ji plus Shibuya Sky and Shibuya sneaker shops; Day 5 (Mar 6) Koenji vintage and food plus last Tokyo shopping; Day 6 (Mar 7) Shinkansen to Osaka, then Amerikamura and Dotonbori; Day 7 (Mar 8) Nakazakicho and Shinsaibashi, then Ura-Namba nightlife. Flights: open-jaw suggested, into Tokyo (HND preferred, or NRT) and out of KIX. There are no nonstops RDU–Tokyo or KIX–RDU. Nov 23 research found no exact-date March 2027 fares. KAYAK lists March as one of the most expensive months on RDU–Tokyo, averaging about $717 round trip. An Expedia RDU–NRT sale from $761 only covers departures through Feb 18, 2027. Travelocity shows RDU–KIX round trips at $964–$1,132. The open-jaw fare still needs a multi-city search. December fares (AA $945–$1,099, United $970) are stale. Tokyo hotels, using December one-night quotes that must be re-checked for Mar 2–7: sequence MIYASHITA PARK is the top pick (about $187/night with taxes in December; 4-star; design-forward; rooftop bar; 3-min walk to Shibuya Metro Exit B1; 17:00 check-in, 14:00 checkout). Shibuya Granbell is the value backup (about $130 with taxes). Hotel Indigo Tokyo Shibuya is over budget (about $348). Osaka hotel candidates, with no prices verified yet: Hotel the Grandee Shinsaibashi (mid-range boutique with concept rooms, 5-min walk to Shinsaibashi Station, 10-min walk to Namba, near Dotonbori); Hotel 88 Shinsaibashi (3-star boutique, highly rated, 4-min walk to the Glico sign); Randor Hotel Osaka Suites (suite-only, more luxurious, likely above budget). Previous overall budget estimate was $2,655–$3,650 including a $300–600 shopping allowance; it needs to be re-estimated with Osaka and the Shinkansen. No bookings made.
